    Finite-skeleton local change under object deletion #

    For complete finite indecomposable skeletons before and after deletion, extension by zero identifies the post-deletion labels with exactly the ambient labels which vanish on the deleted objects. Consequently the sum of the intrinsic pointwise deletion changes is the difference of the two Auslander--Reiten surpluses.
